snippet: Regulation Crypto Assets doesn’t just affect crypto companies. Why AI's needed to stay compliant The SEC has proposed a new set of rules called Regulation Crypto Assets (Regulation CA) in the US. By name, it’s aimed at making it easier for crypto projects to raise money legally, boosting innovation.
